$$フロンタル$$
「But is that humanity's limit...?」

586:t_1:89.en:
$$フロンタル$$
(That is how it is, $$シャア・アズナブル$$... And you, $$バナージ$$...)

586:t_1:90.en:

586:t_10:5.en:

「Please understand that celebrations for ace pilots will be deferred to another occasion.」

586:t_10:7.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I'd heard he was a very amusing person and was looking forward to meeting him. That's a shame.」

586:t_10:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then, Big Sis, I'll do that bit...!」

586:t_10:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's give it our aaaall today!」

586:t_10:14.en:

587:t_000:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「I won't let you near $$アクシズ$$' nozzles!」

587:t_000:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「You never disappoint, $$アムロ$$! That's what makes you my rival!」

587:t_000:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Why would a man like you do this!?」

587:t_000:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「This is the only way for humanity, kept as $$クロノ$$'s pets, to advance to the next stage!」

587:t_000:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That doesn't justify turning Earth into a dead planet!」

587:t_001:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「Remember all that pain you felt when $$ララァ$$ died! Relive every bit of it!」

587:t_001:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「Why don't you realize you're the one wasting your power!?」

587:t_001:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「Any means will do! Unless Earth is destroyed once, against them...!」

587:t_001:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't give me that! Is that what a man who fought alongside us should say!?」

587:t_001:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You've given in to despair and lost sight of the future! Don't try to drag Earth down with you!!」

587:t_002:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The battlefront is shifting! All units, follow the $$ラー・カイラム$$!」

587:t_003:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「It's $$アクシズ$$! And it's about to fall onto Earth!?」

587:t_003:2.en:
$$メラン$$
「Captain $$ブライト$$! We've confirmed fighting near the front end of $$アクシズ$$!」

587:t_003:3.en:
$$メラン$$
「It appears $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and $c are engaged in combat!」

587:t_003:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What's going on!? I'm right here, but the $$ダブルエックス$$ is there!」

587:t_003:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
「So is the $$ホワイトドール$$...!」

587:t_003:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「That's not all...! Units from $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ that aren't in $c are fighting, too!」

587:t_003:10.en:
$$勝平$$
「Look! The $$νガンダム$$ is fighting the $$サザビー$$!」

587:t_003:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then the person leading $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is...」

587:t_003:13.en:
$$桂$$
「This is the battle between $$シャア・アズナブル$$ and $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$...」

587:t_003:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Is this... the beginning of the era later called the $$黒歴史$$...!?」

587:t_003:15.en:
$$レド$$
「When that asteroid falls onto Earth, the world changes completely...」

587:t_003:16.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The wars continue, and at their end, the $$月光蝶$$ destroys civilization...」

587:t_003:17.en:
$$レド$$
「Then humanity moves into space, mainly around the Moon, and seeks a place to survive in deep space. In that process, the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are born...」

587:t_003:19.en:
$$シャア$$
「...To me, the distorted world $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ spoke of meant a world where $$アクシズ$$ falls.」

587:t_003:20.en:
$$シャア$$
「That's why I wanted to understand the me in a world where $$アクシズ$$ falls...」

587:t_003:21.en:
$$万丈$$
「So that wish acted on the $$時空震動$$ and transported $c...」

587:t_003:22.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That is the only explanation we can give.」

587:t_003:23.en:
$$メラン$$
「The light from $$アクシズ$$' nozzles seems to be preventing $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ from spotting us.」

587:t_003:24.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What do we do, $$ブライト$$?」

587:t_003:26.en:
$$シン$$
「There's no time to hesitate! If $$アクシズ$$ falls, this world will enter the $$黒歴史$$!」

587:t_003:27.en:
$$シン$$
「Let's fight too, and stop that world's Colonel $$シャア$$!」

587:t_003:28.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Hold on, $$シン$$! If the $$黒歴史$$ never happens, what happens to me, $$ロラン$$, and $$レド$$, who are from later eras!?」

587:t_003:29.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Could we end up never existing, and disappear right here and now!?」

587:t_003:30.en:
$$オルソン$$
「No... Even then, a parallel world would simply branch off. It won't affect us.」

587:t_003:32.en:
$$オルソン$$
「If $$アクシズ$$ doesn't fall in this world, the $$黒歴史$$ resulting from it won't happen, and you may never be born in its future.」

587:t_003:33.en:
$$オルソン$$
「But the world that went through the $$黒歴史$$ will continue to exist as a separate parallel world. The same is true of you.」

587:t_003:34.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Then there's no problem! Let's hurry up and stop $$アクシズ$$!」

587:t_003:35.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hang on, me from this world! I'll be there to help you in a second!」

587:t_003:36.en:
$$シャア$$
「...But is that really the right thing to do...?」

587:t_003:38.en:
$$甲児$$
「We can't sit quietly while so many people are about to lose their lives in front of us!」

587:t_003:39.en:
$$アルト$$
「Are you going to tell us, like $$フル・フロンタル$$, that we mustn't distort the proper course of history!?」

587:t_003:40.en:
$$シャア$$
「That's not what I mean. I question whether we, as foreign elements, have the right to interfere in this world.」

587:t_003:41.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Good and evil aren't the issue here. It's a question of whether we should interfere with history from the perspective of gods.」

587:t_003:42.en:
$$宗介$$
「Would our intervening here be no different from what $$レナード$$ tried to do...?」

587:t_003:43.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's true... We outsiders probably shouldn't decide where this world is headed.」

587:t_003:44.en:
$$赤木$$
「You say that, but can we get back to our own world!?」

587:t_003:45.en:
$$正太郎$$
「If we can't return, we'll have to live in this world...」
